incident-bot: Pager | SEV2 | inference-embed-queue tail latency spike in us-west2. 20% requests >3s. auto-runbook triggered: https://internal/runbooks/embed-queue
maya (eng-sre): I'm on it, pulling logs now. Notifying runtime.
sam (oncall): I'm taking pager. Current obs: queue depth 48, backpressure enabled on hostpool-a. Restarting worker group gw-embed-01 to try soft-recover.
sam (oncall): run: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/gw-embed --namespace=prod-usw2` -> kicked, watching
maya (eng-sre): After restart, p95 down from 3.2s -> 1.1s on a subset. Still seeing periodic bursts. Capturing flame graphs and traces.
dylan (eng-runtime): Thanks. Initial hypothesis: kv-cache eviction thrash + one model shard acting slow. Can we pin to small model variant as fallback? I can push a routing fallback for the affected route.
caroline (product): Any user-facing impact? Are customers seeing errors or just latency? We need to know scope for credits.
maya (eng-sre): No 5xx's seen; higher latency causing degraded UX for ~1200 requests/min from top 3 tenants. I'll fill customer-impact template.
jessica (ops): Post-incident: we should schedule a postmortem and create action items. Propose: PM, SRE, Runtime, and Product in the postmortem. Who can own the remediation tickets?
sam (oncall): I'll own immediate mitigation follow-ups (kv-cache tuning + autoscale guard). Estimate sizing: 1.5 days (medium).
dylan (eng-runtime): I'll own routing fallback + model-variant testing. Rough estimate: 2.5 days (medium-large) including QA.
maya (eng-sre): I'll own monitoring alerts and test harness updates (0.5 day - small).
caroline (product): I will own customer comms + credit calc (0.5 day). Tie action items into Q4 reliability sprint backlog. Recommend priority: P1 for remediation until autoscale/kv fixes deployed.
jessica (ops): OK. Action items:
- sam (oncall) -> kv-cache eviction tuning + autoscale guard (estimate: 1.5d) [P1]
- dylan (eng-runtime) -> routing fallback + model-variant failover test (estimate: 2.5d) [P1]
- maya (eng-sre) -> alert thresholds and load test harness (0.5d) [P2]
- caroline (product) -> customer scope + credit calc (0.5d) [P1]
We'll create tickets and link to postmortem. Can everyone confirm ETA and ownership so I can create the tickets?
sam (oncall): Confirmed.
dylan (eng-runtime): Confirmed.
maya (eng-sre): Confirmed.
caroline (product): Confirmed.
jessica (ops): I'll open the postmortem and a remediation epic linking these tickets. Tentative postmortem meeting: tomorrow 11:00 PT. If any conflicts, reply here.
caroline (product): 11:00 PT works for me. Add invite.
maya (eng-sre): Works.
dylan (eng-runtime): works for me. I'll bring perf graphs.
sam (oncall): I'll post runbook notes and timeline in the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident resolved -> SEV2 -> status: mitigated. Postmortem scheduled: 3609952000 (calendar event id).
